_meta.source: Especificacoes Tecnicas Codigo de Barras Bidimensional (Codigo QR), Autoridade Tributaria e Aduaneira, 18 pages
_meta.legal_basis: Decreto-Lei n.o 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro, art. 4.o; Portaria n.o 195/2020, de 13 de agosto
_meta.extraction_note: Field names, max lengths and instructions were read from the AT specification document itself, not from a secondary summary. Earlier drafts of this skill used a practitioner blog post and consequently omitted the J*, K*, L, M and P fields entirely, which silently disabled reconciliation for every Azores, Madeira, stamp-duty and withholding invoice.
_meta.verify_before_relying: Re-read the AT specification before trusting this for a filing. Field semantics track the SAF-T (PT) schema and can change with it.

order_note: Ponto 3 b) of the specification: fields are concatenated in the table order. This parser does not require the order, but a field appearing out of order is a sign the payload was reassembled by something other than a certified program.

A.name: nif_emitente
A.desc: NIF do emitente, sem prefixo do pais.

B.name: nif_adquirente
B.desc: NIF do adquirente. 999999990 = consumidor final. Max 30 chars because a foreign buyer's tax id may appear here - it is NOT always a 9-digit Portuguese NIF.

I1.name: espaco_fiscal_pt
I1.desc: TaxCountryRegion. 'PT' continente. '0' quando o documento nao indica taxa de IVA.

L.name: nao_sujeito
L.desc: Nao sujeito / nao tributavel em IVA. Counts toward the document total.

M.name: imposto_selo
M.desc: Imposto do Selo. Counts toward N, which is NOT IVA alone.

N.name: total_impostos
N.desc: TaxPayable = total de IVA E Imposto do Selo.

R.name: num_certificado
R.desc: N.o do certificado atribuido pela AT.

S.name: outras_informacoes
S.desc: Campo livre. Nao pode conter o caracter asterisco.

reconciliation.P_excluded: Retencoes na fonte are withheld from payment, not added to the document total.
reconciliation.verified: Both formulas reproduce all four worked examples in the AT specification exactly, to the cent, including the 513600.58 invoice that spans continente + Acores + Madeira + imposto do selo + retencao.

tipo_documento.note: FT fatura, FS fatura simplificada, FR fatura-recibo, NC nota de credito (negative), PF pro-forma (NOT a purchase - no deduction, no guarantee), GT/GR guias de transporte/remessa. A pro-forma or transport document must never produce a deduction row: the AT's own examples 3 and 4 are exactly these, which is why they are in the golden corpus.
tipo_documento.source: Tipologia SAF-T (PT), referenced by the QR specification rather than restated in it.

estado_documento.unknown_policy: Any state whose deduction consequence is not ESTABLISHED is flagged and not trusted. The QR specification defers the state list to the SAF-T (PT) typology and does not itself say which states carry a deduction, so N and A are the only two this skill will act on. Treating F or S as deductible would be a guess with money attached.
estado_documento.source: Tipologia SAF-T (PT). Deduction consequence of F/S/R NOT established from a primary source at time of writing - see documented_gaps.

documented_gaps.gap: Estado do documento F / S / R
documented_gaps.modelled: flagged as unknown, never treated as deductible
documented_gaps.direction: UNDER-claims: a legitimately deductible F document is flagged for review rather than passed. Chosen over the opposite error, which would silently claim a deduction that may not exist.

Q (4 hash chars) and R (certificate number) are parsed and never verified. This skill cannot distinguish a genuine AT-generated QR from a hand-authored string. It validates STRUCTURE and ARITHMETIC, not authenticity.

The declared IVA is checked against the declared base for plausibility against the statutory rates, but the correct rate depends on the goods sold, which the QR does not contain. A wrong-but-consistent rate can pass.
Ponto 3 b) requires table order. This parser accepts any order, so a reassembled payload is not detected on that basis alone.
